description.narrative: This project identifies areas that could be strengthened for countries to be more resilient and reduce vulnerabilities of countries to shocks. Commonwealth countries, of which 32 are small states, are increasingly vulnerable to external shocks such as climate change and more recently, the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic. In 2020, the pandemic had adverse effects on tourism, a contact sector that is a major contributor to Commonwealth Small States? economies. Consequently, unemployment increased, governments endured severe revenue losses leading to debt sustainability challenges, with vulnerable populations experiencing an increase in inequality and rise in poverty, further entrenching vulnerability in Commonwealth developing countries. This project will analyse and identify vulnerabilities within member countries, identify policy options and provide technical assistance aimed at strengthening resilience.
